# Worlds

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/scene/`](../folders/src-scene.md)
> **Source:** [`src/scene/world.h`](../../../src/scene/world.h), [`src/scene/world.cpp`](../../../src/scene/world.cpp)

## Summary

The scene's worlds, in index order (host context variable in dynamical).

## Description

Emplaced in the host registry by Game::start only when the scene has worlds; filled by Worlds::create(scene, RunArgs::seed), then preinit/init with the host systems, and finished in ~Game. Not copyable. ScenarioRunner owns its own Worlds member (not in a registry). Read by WorldStepperSys (steps it), WorldViewSys, SphereViewSys, RollerPlayerSys and ModelWatcherSys (which inserts a PolicyHandle into each world registry).

## Scene JSON

scene "worlds": [{ "template", "count", "systems", "variables", "variable_files" }] (see the scene loader)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |

| `list` | `std::vector<std::unique_ptr<World>>` | empty | the worlds; index i holds WorldInfo.index == i |
